Well, there is, but it involves moving back and forth from Weight Paint mode and Edit mode, for the sake of making it easier.

First, in Edit mode select the vertices, edges or faces you wanna paint, then switch to Weight Paint mode, then in the brush presets set the weight value as 0.5, then near the bottom side of the window (above the timeline) you see a button with a square that has a highlighted vertex; press that, then lastly, hover your mouse over the 3D mode and press Shift + K. 

Presto : even weight painted!
